scope: Phase 13: real synthetic speech waveform, real configured Bailian STT and FireRed pVAD, installed LiveKit 1.7.1 local audio EOT v1-mini versus current text EOT. Scripted reply LLM/TTS, real-time input, memory audio sink. Not human recordings, real reply generation, RTC/AEC/device or production RPC acceptance.
decision: Do not adopt the experimental audio-detector substitution. Normal-speed conditional pause protection does not survive slow speech, ordinary complete inputs often wait about 3 s, and one fast-reply case commits incomplete/reordered text. These are integration observations, not a general model-quality ranking.
test_only_changes: Allow existing ReplyLatencyProbe to measure acoustic/sink timing when a streaming detector has no predict_end_of_turn method; preserve text-detector behavior.
Parameterize the existing acoustic-clock regression for both detector interfaces. No new orchestration or provider abstraction.

setup.pause_transform: Insert 2.2 seconds of silence inside the existing synthesized clause pause, without splicing independently synthesized phrases. Original pause remains. Normal conditional cut=1.82 s, continuation=1.88 s; question cut=1.30 s, continuation=1.37 s. Slow cut and continuation times divided by .7 before insertion.
setup.native_adapter_boundary: Test-process replacement of StreamingPipeline._turn_detection only. Does not preserve the production text-only InterruptAwareTurnDetector settlement wrapper. No overlapping assistant speech in these tests; suitability for full-duplex interruption settlement is unverified. No source or dependency edit to SDK.
setup.native_observation: Public stream/predict result future instrumented only in experiment; inference_duration present and no fallback/degraded flags in observed records. Native inference roughly 13-17 ms, not the full reply latency.
setup.public_event_check: Installed AgentActivity.on_eot_prediction forwards to a session host; it does not emit a public local AgentSession eot_prediction event. No SDK hook was added.

sample_limitations: One run per detector/condition, sequential current then audio, remote ASR latency varies. No P95 or causal A/B latency claim.
Native returned prediction time is not consumed prediction time. Do not infer an SDK delay defect solely from a positive native score.
The native fast intro receives channel final-ASR EOT update at +2986.7 ms, immediately before the +2994.4 ms reply; this corrects an earlier suspicion of extra SDK endpoint waiting.
Channel timeline is reset/reused across candidates; from_acoustic_stop_ms can omit a provider final or show the first fragment. Raw final_eot_predictions preserves later observed final-ASR updates.
Small closed-form synthetic diagnostic corpus; no calibrated accuracy or evidence of best model.

ptt_engineering_review.finding: The previously measured task-finished to return gap lies in awaited WebSocket cleanup. No fixed sleep was found on that path. Moving it off the reply path requires owned cleanup and cancellation/shutdown/next-press validation; no fire-and-forget change was made.
